message:
## Cohort 01 is frozen

The independent, condition-blind review of **P01, P03, P06, P09, P10, P13, P16 and P18** is complete and frozen at **2026-11-01 09:28:24 UTC**. I received no condition mapping, inspected original product captures, and exercised representative core interactions in every product. All preview processes I started have been stopped.

The [complete blind review](sandbox:/workspace/scratch/e1cfe6e447ee/ui-study/independent-review-recovery/BLIND-REVIEW.md) contains the findings, within-task comparisons, supporting evidence and limitations.

### Independent judgments

| Product | Task family | Frozen judgment | Main finding |
|---|---|---|---|
| **P01** | T4, bounded notification integration | Satisfactory within bounded scope | The native Tabler action toast supports failure, retry of the failed snapshot, preservation of a newer draft, dismissal and focus recovery. |
| **P03** | T1, settings | Satisfactory in exercised scope | Clear settings hierarchy, readable error feedback, and multiline long values at narrow width. Save, cancel, failure recovery, validation and reload persistence worked. |
| **P06** | T1, settings | Satisfactory in exercised scope | A compact, coherent settings layout with readable long values. The exercised persistence and recovery flows worked; status styling is quieter than P03 but remains legible. |
| **P09** | T2, conversation | Satisfactory in exercised scope | Compact attachment disclosure, workable constrained composer, and successful return to the latest streamed content. Manual scrolling, failure recovery and retry were exercised. |
| **P10** | T2, conversation | Revision required | **Return to latest did not reliably reach or follow the latest content during streaming.** Attachment disclosure and other exercised conversation flows worked. |
| **P13** | T3, wiki | Core supported; narrow-layout revision required | The Notebook-based reading experience and native bilingual editing worked, including disk persistence and reload. **The narrow Evidence ledger table overflows the viewport and cuts off an important column.** |
| **P16** | T1, settings | Core supported; narrow-layout revision required | Persistence and recovery worked, but the expanded narrow navigation pushes the main form down, and representative long names and organizations remain horizontally clipped. |
| **P18** | T4, bounded notification integration | Satisfactory within bounded scope | The native action toast preserves the required retry semantics and newer draft, with useful save-time and unsaved-edit feedback. |

These judgments apply to each product’s own supplied task. In particular, the bounded T4 notification work was not judged against the broader T1 settings redesign requirements.

### Material unresolved findings

**P10’s return-to-latest behavior is the strongest functional blocker.** In the targeted completion run, the distance from the bottom grew from approximately **679 px immediately after the click to 2,134 px when the response finished**. It remained about **798 px away after another 600 ms**. A second click after completion reached the bottom. In the corresponding P09 follow-up, the bottom gap stayed at zero over the sampled interval. The retained source inspection suggests a possible scroll-behavior contributor, but the review does not claim a proven implementation-level cause. The detailed run is retained in [P10’s completion follow-up evidence](sandbox:/workspace/scratch/e1cfe6e447ee/ui-study/independent-review-recovery/evidence/behavior-return-latest-001/P10.json).

**P13’s main editing workflow is supported by direct persistence evidence.** I edited both English and Chinese passages through the native editor, confirmed the changed file on disk, reloaded, and verified that discarding a later draft preserved the saved version. The remaining layout problem is concrete: at a 390 px viewport, the Evidence ledger table measured approximately **440 px wide**, with its right edge near **455 px**, cutting off the “Does not establish” column in the viewed image. Horizontal-panning recovery was not tested, so I have not described that content as permanently inaccessible.

**P16’s unresolved scope concerns narrow presentation.** The main name field starts around **760 px down** in the narrow layout, and the long-value field has approximately **656 px of content within 330 px of visible width**. Its successful data behavior does not resolve those presentation requirements.

Earlier browser-launch and wiki-selector failures remain in the evidence alongside successful follow-ups. The initial broad P10 stop check was also retained and investigated: focused sampling showed a short settling period followed by stable text, so that early result is **not treated as proof of indefinite generation after stopping**.

### Frozen deliverables

- [BLIND-REVIEW.md](sandbox:/workspace/scratch/e1cfe6e447ee/ui-study/independent-review-recovery/BLIND-REVIEW.md) — complete independent review.
- [Immutable cohort product records](sandbox:/workspace/scratch/e1cfe6e447ee/ui-study/independent-review-recovery/cohorts/2026-11-01-cohort-01/products.json) — all eight judgments, concrete findings, original capture paths, actual view exports, additional viewed images and behavior evidence.
- [Cumulative products.json](sandbox:/workspace/scratch/e1cfe6e447ee/ui-study/independent-review-recovery/products.json) — current cumulative record; later cohorts may append without rewriting these judgments.
- [EVIDENCE-INDEX.json](sandbox:/workspace/scratch/e1cfe6e447ee/ui-study/independent-review-recovery/cohorts/2026-11-01-cohort-01/EVIDENCE-INDEX.json) — actual image-view provenance and hashes of retained evidence and review scripts.
- [FREEZE-MANIFEST.json](sandbox:/workspace/scratch/e1cfe6e447ee/ui-study/independent-review-recovery/cohorts/2026-11-01-cohort-01/FREEZE-MANIFEST.json) — verified SHA-256 hashes for the immutable report and records.

**Manifest SHA-256:**  
`887a5940dc738e9f73d2d367454aa96c848d06e15de5ca02b615f0de89b52630`

The original product captures remain unchanged. Isolation was maintained by instruction on a shared host, rather than a separate security sandbox. The report distinguishes observed pixels, exercised behavior, source inspection, inference and unknowns; it is an independent agent review, not a human usability or assistive-technology certification. No comparator was repaired, and any later cohort or post-unblinding disposition must be recorded separately.
